references.prompt: Create one highly detailed, realistic anatomical human eyeball reference for image-to-3D production in a children's science education application. One single complete eyeball, from slightly above and three-quarter front so both its round spherical volume and brown iris/pupil are clearly visible. A short natural optic nerve stump at the back, no eye socket, eyelids, eyebrow, face, surrounding muscles, labels, text, cuts or detached pieces. Natural creamy off-white sclera with extremely subtle sparse fine vessels; realistic radially detailed brown iris, sharply black round pupil, transparent cornea with restrained soft specular reflection. Anatomically plausible proportions: iris diameter less than half the eyeball diameter; no huge anime iris; round volume not a flat disk. Clean non-bloody educational anatomy, lifelike tissue microdetails, no gore, no diagram colors, no purple teal or neon palette. Soft neutral diffuse studio lighting, tack sharp all-over focus. Isolated on pure white seamless background, centered full silhouette with generous 10% margin, no shadow plane or props. Highest-quality photorealistic scientific asset reference.
